headlines.title: Elon Musk is flying under the radar in the Texas Senate race. Republicans like it that way.
headlines.description: The last time Elon Musk sank money into an election, he played a starring role in the 2025 state Supreme Court race in Wisconsin.

headlines.title: Poll: Most voters say Trump has hurt the economy as competitive midterm election looms
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s sinking ratings threaten to drag down Republicans in November’s midterm elections, as voters blame him for high prices and a shaky economy, according to a new NBC News poll.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.
